title: Agent Onboarding Requirement
description: One requirement an onboarding mode imposes, discriminated by kind. Only aao_verified, storyboard, and experimental_feature carry fields; other kinds are the kind alone. The requirement describes the gate the publishing party applies on its own side; it creates no conformance obligation on the counterparty.

role.description: aao_verified: the badge role required, such as media-buy.

verification_modes.description: aao_verified: accepted verification modes, as the badge token names them.

specialisms.description: aao_verified: specialisms the badge must include.

adcp_version.description: aao_verified: the AdCP release the badge must cover.

id.description: storyboard: the storyboard or specialism id. experimental_feature: the feature id.
